description: Sewer Outfalls is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. This dataset provides pertinent information on the general location of sewer system outfalls and the classification by flow medium. The data is updated on a continual daily basis. The data is intended to support development and growth by facilitating pre-application discussions and preparation of servicing reports by Developers (and their teams). Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are sewage. It offers 8 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPKG, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
